quickAnswer.heading: San Luis Potosí at a glance (2026)
quickAnswer.intro: San Luis Potosí is the capital of the state of San Luis Potosí, Mexico — a UNESCO-connected colonial city of approximately 1.31 million people in the metropolitan area, sitting at 1,864 meters elevation in the central Bajío region. For foreigners moving to Mexico in 2026, SLP offers roughly 35–50% lower living costs than Mexico City for a similar quality of life, direct flights to Houston and Dallas, over 350 international companies (BMW, General Motors, Valeo, Continental), and a rapidly growing digital-nomad infrastructure of 51+ coworking spaces. The city works for three profiles: long-term expats, remote workers on temporary residency, and slow travelers exploring the Bajío and the Huasteca Potosina.
keyFacts: Comfortable solo budget: $1,200–$2,000 USD / month (single), $1,800–$2,500 (couple), $2,400–$3,500 (family of four)
1BR apartment in Centro Histórico: $450–$750 USD / month (2026 market)
Temporary Resident visa income threshold (2026): ~$4,185 USD/month or ~$69,750 USD in savings — fees doubled November 2025
Fiber internet 100–500 Mbps available in Centro, Lomas, Tangamanga — $32–$50 USD/month
Healthcare: Hospital Ángeles, Star Médica, Hospital Lomas — private consult $30–$60 USD
US State Department advisory: Level 2 — Exercise Increased Caution (same as France)
MXN/USD exchange rate in March 2026: approximately 17.5

overview.heading: Why should expats move to San Luis Potosí?
keyAdvantages: ~26% lower cost of living than Mexico City (housing up to 55% cheaper)
overview.economicStability: Economic Stability: The state's GDP grew 7.9% in 2023, making it Mexico's third-fastest growing economy (after Quintana Roo and Oaxaca). Key sectors include automotive (BMW, GM), aerospace, logistics, and business services.

visas.heading: Which Mexican visa do I need to live in SLP?

processSteps.title: Schedule Consulate Appointment
processSteps.desc: Book 2-4 weeks in advance through SRE Consulate Directory

processSteps.title: Gather Documents
processSteps.desc: Valid passport (6+ months validity), completed application, passport photo, proof of financial solvency, visa fee ($50-$80 USD)

processSteps.title: Prove Financial Solvency
processSteps.desc: Bank statements: ~$69,750 USD average balance (12 months), OR monthly income: ~$4,185 USD for 6 months

processSteps.title: Exchange Visa Upon Entry
processSteps.desc: Visit INM office within 30 days (Av. Venustiano Carranza 2395, Tel: 444 812-3556)

processSteps.title: Receive Resident Card
processSteps.desc: Valid for 1 year, renewable up to 4 years

visas.warning: Warning: Working remotely on a tourist visa while earning from Mexico technically violates immigration law, though enforcement is limited. Obtain proper residency status for work activities.

items.q: Do I need to speak Spanish?
items.a: While English is available in tourist areas, Spanish is essential for daily life. Unlike San Miguel de Allende, there's limited English infrastructure. Consider classes at CELE (UASLP) or private tutors (~$10-15 USD/hour).

items.q: Can I work remotely on a tourist visa?
items.a: Working remotely on a tourist visa is technically a gray area. While enforcement is minimal for remote workers earning from abroad, obtaining Temporary Residency is safer for long-term stays and provides access to banking and healthcare.

items.q: Can I use my foreign driver's license?
items.a: Valid for 6 months as tourist. Once resident, obtain Mexican license (proof of residency, medical exam, written/practical tests). Cost: ~$50-100 USD total.

items.q: Is San Luis Potosí good for digital nomads in 2026?
items.a: Yes and growing fast. The city has 51+ coworking spaces as of March 2026 (vs ~25 in 2024), fiber internet at 100-500 Mbps in all major neighborhoods, and direct flights to Houston and Dallas. Monthly nomad budget averages $1,800 USD. Entidad Nómada in Centro Histórico is the default first-stop coworking space.

items.q: What changed in Mexican residency visas for 2026?
items.a: Two things: (1) In July 2025, Mexican consulates shifted to UMA-based economic solvency calculations instead of minimum wage. For 2026 the threshold is ~$4,185 USD monthly income or ~$69,750 USD in savings. (2) Government processing fees for residency visas and cards were roughly doubled effective November 7, 2025.

items.q: How many days should a tourist plan for San Luis Potosí?
items.a: 3 days for the city (Centro Histórico, Parque Tangamanga, a day trip to Real de Catorce). Add 3-4 more days for the Huasteca Potosina (Cascada de Tamul, Xilitla Surrealist Gardens, Tamasopo). A full state visit is 7-8 days.
